final_observable_contract: If an MCP stdio child environment lacks PATH, a bare unknown command must not be resolved from the parent process PATH or add the parent executable directory to the child environment, even when the child supplies a differing PATHEXT. An explicitly empty child PATH remains distinct from a missing PATH.
